_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — copy to manifest.json and point audio_path at real files.
Required per track: track_id, title, artist, audio_path.
Optional: source, license, provider_url. Unknown keys are rejected, but
keys starting with _ are treated as comments and ignored.
Relative audio_path values resolve against this file's folder.
Anything libsndfile decodes works (wav, flac, ogg, mp3); no ffmpeg needed.
Tracks under 30 seconds yield fewer than three excerpts.
Audio itself is git-ignored (data/audio/) — share the files out of band.
